title: Spring 2026 Manga Guide
partialText: An arranged marriage doesn't quite go as planned in the yuri fantasy <b>Marrying the Dark Knight (For Her Money)</b>! Plus a charming new fairy tale-style fantasy, a magical girl, and the inevitable Junji Ito short story collection as the Manga Guide continues.
